text: Artificial intelligence, or AI, is a technology that allows computers to think and learn in ways that are similar to humans. Machine learning is a part of AI where computers learn from data and improve over time without being programmed for every task. Deep learning is a more advanced form of machine learning that uses large neural networks to solve complex problems, like recognizing faces or understanding speech. Today, AI is used in many daily activities. For example, it helps recommend movies on streaming services, powers voice assistants on phones, and even helps doctors find diseases. AI is becoming a normal part of modern life.
